thread:
mira.secops: Heads-up — external pen-test intake landed from RedTeam Labs. They want a quick triage call tomorrow and a retest week after. Need RBAC, KMS evidence, and log sampling plan ready.

jonah.eng: Copy. Can you drop the report PDF and scope in the tracker? I'll pull the list of impacted services.

mira.secops: Uploaded the report to the intake folder: https://corp-storage/redwood/pt-intake/2356709876/report.pdf. Core asks: ephemeral assessor roles for 72h, S3 access to logs, KMS decrypt permissions for assessor account, and access to the staging environment.

sasha.sre: For logs: retention >= 30d for audit, but we can surface 7d of full traces for the window. Question: do they need raw instance logs or aggregated traces?

kevin.infosec: They requested full raw logs for hosts in-scope. We should redact secrets. Also we must ensure KMS CMK policy allows the assessor IAM role to Decrypt for the evidence bundle.

elena.pm: Call tomorrow 10am PT works for stakeholders. Can we propose retest slots Wed/Thu next week?

jonah.eng: Retest slots: Wed 09:00-12:00 PT, Thu 13:00-16:00 PT. I'll reserve maintenance window and notify ops.

mira.secops: Quick remediation tracker created: https://tracker/board/pt-2356709876. Please add items with owner and target fix date. We need RBAC change PRs and KMS policy changes queued.

sasha.sre: Outline of actions I'm taking:
```
- snapshot logs from 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-19 (in-scope window)
- create presigned evidence bundle S3 URL (expires 7d)
- run log-sampling script to extract auth/crypto events at 1:1 sampling for suspects, 1:100 for noise
```

jonah.eng: For RBAC: propose ephemeral roles via AWS STS AssumeRole with session tags. PR to add assessors to `assessor-role` with `DurationSeconds=259200` (72h). I can draft the IAM policy.

kevin.infosec: Two compliance asks: ensure KMS key access is logged to CloudTrail and that CloudTrail logs are delivered to immutable bucket with MFA-delete. Also keep a short justification note for auditors.

mira.secops: Good call. Will include an evidence checklist on the tracker: KMS policy diff, CloudTrail export screenshot, presigned evidence URL, RBAC PR link, and a list of supplied logs (hosts/services).

elena.pm: On the call agenda, let's include: 1) scope confirmation, 2) evidence handoff mechanism, 3) retest slot confirmation, 4) post-remediation verification plan.

assessor-bot: Reminder: please accept the onboarding NDA to enable assessor access: https://assessors.redwood/onboard/abc123

jonah.eng: One more: we should run a dry-run of the assessor role creation in staging today to validate IAM and KMS decrypt access. I'll post the dry-run output here.

sasha.sre: Dry-run note: when creating the presigned S3 evidence URL, make sure the KMS key ARN is used in PutObject call and the `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header is present — otherwise objects won't be decryptable by the assessor key binding.

mira.secops: OK folks — agenda and tracker links posted, call invite sent to @jonah.eng @sasha.sre @kevin.infosec @elena.pm and RedTeam rep. Action owners: add your PR links to the tracker before EOD. We'll reconvene after the call to lock the retest slot. :white_check_mark:
